integrity: The complete foundational four-page article was inspected directly, including its NE6 table row and period-doubling figure. The full accessible fractional-order follow-up was inspected around its NE6 construction and numerical analysis. The exact generator identities and source parameter specialization were replayed from the packaged standard-library checker. The parameter trichotomy follows analytically from invariant-measure stationarity and invariant-support tangency, not from numerical enumeration.
scientific_limitations: For positive a, the theorem gives necessary identities for compact invariant probability measures but does not prove such a measure exists for every parameter.
The source's chaotic attractor at a=3/4 is numerical evidence rather than an existence theorem supplied here.
The identities determine selected moments and conditional means, not the complete invariant distribution.
The fractional-order follow-up is dynamically different and is used only for comparison.
A differently phrased or unindexed stationary-balance observation could remain unlocated.
title: Exact stationary RMS law and a sharp recurrence boundary for the Jafari–Sprott NE6 flow
